label: r2c4
name: Hybrid: DONE-frame mix + cell attention
hypothesis: This sums the 32-candidate frame × order × DONE-position window mixture and the per-action cell-attention head, both at gain 0.01, on a width-32 trunk. The structured candidates can lock on quickly if the layout is a shifted or dihedral one, and the attention head catches any unstructured remainder. Expect a score at least as high as the better of candidates 1 and 2, with a higher minimum seed. If it trails both, combining the heads makes credit assignment harder, and round 3 should keep only one.
